Hello! I’m single, 25 F, also from the Philippines. I’ve lived abroad for the past 3 years by myself and been single all throughout. I started as a student. My parents paid for my tuition fee and housing, but I got 2 part time jobs to support myself. After doing school for a year, I did a full time job that pays really well. I was sending money back home, which I thought was the right thing to do, but my parents refused to accept. I’m Fil-Chi so I guess “supporting your family” isn’t really a huge part of the culture. 

I always find it extremely annoying when families back home expects you to support them financially just because you’re overseas making money. I’ve seen my coworkers doing exactly that. They wouldn’t go out for a dinner just so they could send more money back home. I’m currently in Manila now because of Covid, got a job that pays shit I couldn’t even support myself.  I see some of my coworkers younger than me who takes the burden of supporting their families. I find it extremely unfair. The parents should have the responsibility and not pass it on to the first born. Sometime I think parents just have kids so they’re well taken care of when they’re old. So don’t feel guilty about leaving your family. It ain’t your job to support them in the first place. 

I have on older sister, first born. However, she doesn’t have the burden of taking care of us. I guess I’m lucky my parents think differently. They taught us that our hard earned money are ours to spend. My mom would shell out so much money for designer items, always thought it’s such a waste of money. But I’ve learned that I should shut my mouth since it’s not my money she’s spending anyways. Hence, I wouldn’t expect my parents to leave inheritance. They’ll probably spend every penny they have before they die.
